title.value: AnveshanaAI: A Multimodal Platform for Adaptive AI/ML Education Through Automated Question Generation and Interactive Assessment

TLDR.value: AnveshanaAI is a gamified, adaptive platform for AI/ML education with automated question generation and explainable assessments.

abstract.value: We propose AnveshanaAI, an application-based learning platform for artificial intelligence. With AnveshanaAI, learners are presented with a personalized dashboard featuring streaks, levels, badges, and structured navigation across domains such as data science, machine learning, deep learning, transformers, generative AI, large language models, and multimodal AI, with scope to expand in future. Our portal designs gamified tracking with points and achievements to enhance engagement and learning, while switching between Playground, Challenges, Simulator, Dashboard, and Community supports exploration and collaboration. Rather than relying on static question repositories like existing platforms, we ensure balanced progression through a 10k+ dataset grounded in Bloom’s taxonomy, with semantic similarity checks and explainable AI techniques improving transparency, reliability, and adaptivity through automated domain-aware assessment. Experiments depict broad dataset coverage and stable fine-tuning with reduced perplexity. These features illustrate how AnveshanaAI integrates adaptivity, gamification, interactivity, and explainability to support next-generation AI education.
